BIG NEWS!

GUYS, YES, I FOUND A LOT OF ISSUES IN THE PREVIOUS FILE I UPLOADED (12 NOV), SO I DECIDED TO START OVER AGAIN!

Hi, just to make it clear, I'm not professional at dis, pls be kind. D:


Update,[b]13 Nov 2024 [/b]: [ Btw I'm using the original eng translation file to amend, I found out there're still many dialogues need to be translate / amend, I'll try my best to translate it asap. In fact I'm considering to remove Bu Wang in my save record (idk how tho lemme try) and start over again (cuz I'm ady at 10 heart when I decided to translate it), I think it's better for me to see which should be translated in this case.]
[/b]
I noticed that the previous translator has deleted their account, and after thinking it over, I decided to try translating it myself. And also, I realized the original translations were a bit off and unclear, which left me a bit confused while reading the NPC dialogues. I had to read the Chinese ver to see what was going on, haha.

I spent a couple of days on it, I think it should be pretty understandable. I might’ve missed a few things though, like some conversations about the weather after marriage ilfe or three meals related conversation, etc.

I also fixed the character name from 'I Bu Wang' to 'Yu Bu Wang,' since '余' means 'I' or 'me' in Classical Chinese, I believe the previous translator may have made a mistake there.

Welp das it, If I get some free time or run into any weird dialogues while playing, I’ll fix them asap [b](MAYBE)[/b]

And of course, if you guys have any questions or suggestions, or if you spot any odd dialogues, feel free to message or comment!

Byee

PS: English isn’t my first language, I did my best with the translation. You know, translating Classical Chinese to English is a real pain....... *sobs* *dies*
